title: Films and motion | Hazem Radhouani
description: Architectural films of Sentry, Sidi Maarouf and Zenata stations, and motion graphic reels by Hazem Radhouani, architect and motion designer.
intro: Architectural film and motion graphic design. After Effects / Illustrator / 2024-2026.
filmsIntro: Architectural renders and animations produced alongside project development.

films.title: Sentry
films.label: Arch Film | Morocco | 2024
films.text: Guard pavilion at Casablanca Finance City. Threshold and access control explored through precise camera movement and material rendering.

films.title: Sidi Maarouf Station
films.label: Arch Film | Morocco | 2025
films.text: Sidi Maarouf RER station, Casablanca. Canopy structure, passenger flows, and the spatial character of the covered public concourse.

films.title: Zenata Station
films.label: Arch Film | Morocco | 2025
films.text: Regional rail station. Structural canopy, covered concourse, and multimodal interchange at the edge of Casablanca. Competition: 2nd place.

reels.title: Beelove
reels.label: Motion Reel | 2025
reels.text: Organic rhythm and pattern through the geometry of bees. Golden ratios, structured movement, and choreographed transitions in After Effects.

reels.title: Trying the Glitch Effect
reels.label: Motion Reel | 2025
reels.text: Digital distortion as graphic language. Signal corruption, chromatic aberration, and scan-line noise as expressive technique in After Effects.

reels.title: Planets
reels.label: Motion Reel | 2026
reels.text: Orbital mechanics and gravitational choreography rendered in geometric abstraction. Slow, precise movement informed by celestial bodies.

about: I am an architect and motion designer based between Paris, Casablanca, and Tunis. My motion work grows directly from architectural practice. A background in reading space, structure, and material informs how I think about timing, camera, and the choreography of ideas on screen.

I work in Adobe After Effects and Adobe Illustrator, and trained through the School of Motion curriculum, a rigorous education that shaped my understanding of easing, anticipation, and the principles that make movement feel right rather than simply correct.

My output ranges from architectural visualisation, where precision and spatial coherence are paramount, to motion graphic reels exploring pattern, texture, and abstraction as a graphic language of their own.
